sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Uri)

rows.label: Minimum tax on real estate
rows.value: A minimum tax on real estate of natural persons who pay less than CHF 300 of cantonal, communal and church taxes in the canton

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)
ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Uri)

rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer)
rows.value: None as such: only land registry or transfer fees are charged (amounts not stored)

source.title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
